description: Fails on master: one POI of Bangchak tagged name:en=Esso gives Bangchak the alternative name Esso, so 'esso' shows the row of Bangchak and lists its stations. The extract thailand_brand_translations is cut out of Thailand_asia_2.obf: the POIs nearest to Bangkok of each brand and up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative).
